plugins.name: dev-automation-suite
plugins.description: Autonomous development across an eleven-phase lifecycle with script-enforced quality gates. Blocks unverified agent deliveries at SubagentStop, halts on breaking changes and unvalidated premises, rejects band-aid fixes, and detects the project stack instead of assuming it. Local files and CLI only — no external services.
